environment: Primary use of Claude Code: an unattended, pre-registered machine learning experiment that runs robot simulations on this machine. Long local simulation jobs started with run/jobs.py are routine.

Host containment: a dedicated cloud VM used only for this experiment. It needs outbound access to huggingface.co and its CDN for read-only downloads of public LeRobot checkpoints and datasets, to PyPI for the pinned Python packages, and to github.com for this repository.
Setup work: installing system packages with apt, and Python packages into the project's .venv with uv or pip, is routine on this VM when a simulation or rendering library is missing.
Source control: the agent commits locally and never pushes, tags or creates releases. A separate script outside the session does that.
